import sys, math, time
import numpy as np

from rcb_client import Robot

Q = np.array([0., 1., 0., 0.])

class Painter:
    def __init__(self, robot=None):
        self.r = robot or Robot()
        self.target = np.asarray(self.r.get_obs(video='none').meta['proprio']['now'][7:14], float)
    def go(self, xyz, speed=.065, settle=0.25, cameras=None, video='none', note='move'):
        end = np.r_[np.asarray(xyz,float), Q]
        d = float(np.linalg.norm(end[:3]-self.target[:3]))
        n = max(1, int(math.ceil(d/max(speed,1e-3)/.05)))
        a = np.array([self.target+(end-self.target)*(i/n) for i in range(1,n+1)], np.float32)
        if settle>0:
            m=int(math.ceil(settle/.05)); a=np.concatenate([a,np.repeat(end[None,:],m,axis=0)],axis=0)
        res=self.r.submit('ee_pose',a,dt=.05,video=video,cameras=cameras,note=note)
        self.target=end
        return res
    def curve(self, xyz, speed=.045, settle=0.0, cameras=None, video='none', note='stroke'):
        pts=np.asarray(xyz,float)
        out=[]
        for b in pts:
            end=np.r_[b,Q]
            d=float(np.linalg.norm(end[:3]-self.target[:3]))
            n=max(1,int(math.ceil(d/max(speed,1e-3)/.05)))
            out.extend([self.target+(end-self.target)*(i/n) for i in range(1,n+1)])
            self.target=end
        if settle>0:
            out.extend([self.target.copy() for _ in range(int(math.ceil(settle/.05)))])
        res=self.r.submit('ee_pose',np.asarray(out,np.float32),dt=.05,video=video,cameras=cameras,note=note)
        return res

+def ordered_strokes(strokes: list[dict], start_xy: np.ndarray) -> list[dict]:

+    order = [7, 9, 12, 2, 4, 6, 3, 5, 1, 11, 8, 10, 13, 14, 15, 16]
+    remaining = {i: [s for s in strokes if s["paint"] == i] for i in range(1, 17)}
+    result: list[dict] = []
+    here = np.asarray(start_xy, dtype=float)
+    for pigment in order:
+        group = remaining[pigment]
+        while group:
+            best = None
+            best_rev = False
+            best_d = float("inf")
+            for j, s in enumerate(group):

+                da, db = float(np.linalg.norm(a - here)), float(np.linalg.norm(b - here))
+                if da < best_d:
+                    best, best_rev, best_d = j, False, da
+                if db < best_d:
+                    best, best_rev, best_d = j, True, db
+            s = group.pop(best)

+        self.rows: list[np.ndarray] = []
+
+    def hold(self, n: int) -> None:
+        for _ in range(max(0, int(n))):
+            self.rows.append(self.target.copy())

+    def move(self, xyz: np.ndarray | list[float], speed: float) -> None:
+        end = np.r_[np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float), Q_DOWN]
+        dist = float(np.linalg.norm(end[:3] - self.target[:3]))
+        n = max(1, int(math.ceil(dist / (speed * 0.05))))
+        delta = end - self.target
+        for j in range(1, n + 1):
+            self.rows.append(self.target + delta * (j / n))
+        self.target = end

+        start, end = pts[0], pts[-1]

+        self.move([start[0], start[1], CONTACT_Z], 0.025)
+        self.hold(1)
+        for p in pts[1:]:
